title: GIC and Coatue co-lead Anthropic's Series H

sources.quote: The round was co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1 Capital Partners, GIC, ICONIQ, and XN.

explain: GIC co-led Anthropic's $65 billion Series H alongside Coatue, ICONIQ and others (counted in full on the Sequoia record). GIC's own amount was not disclosed.
